Politics · India

Rahul Gandhi targets Election Commission officials, announces protest rally

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi announced that the INDIA bloc will hold a rally at Ramlila Maidan on November 1. He stated that people are being prevented from attending. Gandhi also declared that "Gyanesh Kumar is our first target" and that they will "deal with Modi and Shah too." This statement was made during a mock parliament session, which the opposition INDIA alliance referred to as a 'Jan Mahabhog' (public impeachment) program. Gandhi alleged that without Gyanesh Kumar, neither Modi would have become Prime Minister nor Shah the Home Minister.
